title: Add explicit agency service-fee agreement evidence
description: Add a disclosed, auditable agency service-fee agreement evidence register for customer-facing agency services. Preserve explicit commercial terms supplied by authorized users and keep this model separate from salesperson commission reports, customer invoices and receipts. Do not support concealed or off-book commissions, infer terms, issue an invoice, move money, post accounting, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation audits existing customer terms, commission reports and contract fields before adding the register and does not replace or duplicate an existing authoritative agreement model.

Authorized users can create and edit draft agreement evidence with an explicit agreement number, authoritative Customer, effective date range, currency, disclosed fee method, explicit rate or fixed-amount terms when applicable, bounded basis description and bounded notes.
Fee terms are persisted user-supplied evidence; the server does not derive them from salesperson commission settings, historical orders, free text, customer defaults or amount similarity.
The server validates the authoritative Customer and rejects missing, deleted or inactive Customers for new agreements while retaining bounded Customer snapshots for historical reads.
Active agreement identity is unique under a documented normalized Customer and agreement-number rule; duplicates are rejected rather than merged.

Supported fee methods and their required fields are explicit and validated; incompatible rate, fixed amount, currency or basis combinations are rejected without silently normalizing commercial meaning.

Agreements may be recorded and later voided with a bounded reason while preserving original terms, Customer snapshots, recorder and timestamps; recorded or voided evidence is not hard-deleted or silently rewritten.

The UI and documentation state that agreement rows are repository commercial evidence, not a tax invoice, accounting entry, payment authorization, legal advice or proof that a service was delivered or paid.
No field or workflow is provided for concealed, undisclosed or off-book commission handling, and existing salesperson commission reports remain a separate model.
Creating, recording, reading or voiding agreement evidence does not mutate Customers, Sales Orders, containers, invoices, receipts, balances, tax, finance or settlement records.

Schema changes are idempotent, lists are bounded or paged, legacy Customers remain readable without request-time or production backfill, and validation uses only permitted local or test-database paths.

Unit and integration tests cover supported fee methods, invalid term combinations, Customer validation, duplicate identity, effective dates, record and void history, separation from salesperson commission and adjacent-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Create disclosed agency service-fee agreement evidence for an active Customer, verify its explicit currency and fee terms, record it and confirm no invoice, receipt, order or accounting record changes.

Attempt duplicate, invalid-term and inactive-Customer agreements, verify rejection, then void valid recorded evidence and confirm its original terms and audit history remain readable and separate from salesperson commission reports.

human_gate.reason: Repository-only disclosed agreement evidence and non-production validation. Real contracting, invoicing, receipt handling, accounting posting, production database mutation, deployment and release remain behind applicable human gates.
